name: prefrontal-tool-loop-smoke
description: 工具循环压测 — 任务设计为 deepseek 直连（无工具）不可能答对、prefrontal agent（time/json/http 工具循环）可答。delta = 被测物工具循环的净增值。日期类任务按运行日校验（expected 用占位说明）。

tasks.instruction: What is today's date? Use the time tool and answer with just the date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Use the time tool with format=human and timezone=Asia/Shanghai, then tell me the current time exactly as the tool reported it.
What year is it right now? Use the time tool. Answer with just the year.
